nusmp.skill.summoner.description: A Unique Skill born from Hell. Call forth summon cards to fight beside you. Mastery raises how many can answer your call.
nusmp.skill.faith.description: A Unique Skill fueled by devotion. Gather Faith and bestow skills upon those you choose.
nusmp.skill.firebolt.description: Chantless magic. A bolt of lightning-fire fired instantly at whatever you look at.
nusmp.skill.argonaut.description: The wish to become a hero. Hold to charge with the chime of bells, release to strike.
nusmp.skill.liaris_freese.description: While your feelings remain, so does your growth. Your kills may raise the mastery of all your skills.
nusmp.skill.airiel.description: Tempest. Wrap yourself in wind for speed and power, or ride it in a sudden dash.
nusmp.skill.hestia.description: Goddess of the Hearth. Heal and bless yourself and every ally around you.
nusmp.skill.freya.description: Goddess of Beauty. Your Charm makes monsters forget you and leaves enemies dazed.
nusmp.skill.hephaestus.description: Goddess of the Forge. Restore your weapon, and your armor once mastered.
nusmp.skill.loki.description: The Trickster. Vanish from sight and blink forward.
nusmp.skill.wynn_fimbulvetr.description: A 3-line chant. A blizzard that freezes everything at the target.
nusmp.skill.rea_laevateinn.description: A 3-line chant. Pillars of flame erupt around you.
nusmp.skill.arcs_ray.description: A 1-line chant. A piercing beam of light that strikes everything in its path.
nusmp.skill.futsunomitama.description: A 2-line chant. A gravity field that crushes and pins enemies.
nusmp.skill.uchide_no_kozuchi.descriptio: A 3-line chant. Level Boost: greatly raise an ally's power for a time.
nusmp.skill.hell_walker.description: Toggle. The closer you are to death, the harder you hit.
nusmp.skill.hawk_eye.description: Toggle. Bird Card sight: night vision, and hostile creatures around you are revealed.
nusmp.skill.spirit_card.description: Toggle. A healing aura for you and nearby allies.
nusmp.skill.unbreakable_will.description: Passive. Once in a while, survive a killing blow.
nusmp.skill.hati.description: Passive. Absorb fire, lightning and magic, and turn it into strength.
nusmp.skill.lord_of_summons.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Summoner. Double the summons, double their strength, and Beast Card calls a whole pack.
nusmp.skill.goddess_of_faith.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Faith. Bestow for half the Faith and half the wait; prayer yields triple Faith.
nusmp.skill.heros_argonaut.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Argonaut. Charge up to 10 bells and strike with double power.
nusmp.skill.hell_conqueror.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Hell Walker. Near death your blows become devastating, and below half health they heal you.
nusmp.skill.immortal_will.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Unbreakable Will. Rise from a killing blow at full health, far more often.
nusmp.skill.devils_footprints.descriptio: Unique. Flames burst from your feet: dash through the air or deliver a burning kick. Your own fire can't hurt you.
nusmp.skill.adolla_burst.description: Ultimate. Move at the speed of light, striking everything in your path.
nusmp.skill.book_maker.description: Unique. Pin your target with giant screws and drag them down to your level.
nusmp.skill.all_fiction.description: Ultimate. Make injuries, enemies, and even your own death never have happened.
nusmp.skill.six_eyes.description: Unique. Toggle. See every living thing around you through walls and darkness.
nusmp.skill.limitless.description: Ultimate. Infinity stops every attack before it reaches you. Blue, Red and Hollow Purple bend space itself.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience.description: Unique. Give life to heal allies; your blows overload an enemy's senses.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience_requiem.desc: Ultimate. Return to Zero: attacks against you never reach their result.
nusmp.skill.vector_manipulation.descript: Unique. Toggle. Reflect projectiles and turn melee hits back on the attacker.
nusmp.skill.black_wings.description: Ultimate. Total reflection of melee and projectiles, and complete control of your own fall.
nusmp.skill.instant_death.description: Ultimate. Whatever you will to die, dies.
nusmp.skill.the_almighty.description: Ultimate. See every future and choose the one where you are never harmed.
nusmp.skill.the_visionary.description: Ultimate. Whatever you imagine becomes reality.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_magic.description: The magic of your grimoire. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires are stronger and cheaper to cast from.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_flame.description: Grimoire magic: Flame Magic. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires cast stronger and cheaper.

nusmp.skill.page_chrono_stasis.descripti: The page does not ask. It folds the seconds in front of you into a single held breath, and the one you chose is caught inside it: no step, no swing, no fall. Strike them as often as you like; every wound waits politely until their time resumes, and then it arrives all at once.
nusmp.skill.page_chrono_stasis_grigora.d: You stop asking the clock for single seconds and take the whole room. Inside the circle, arrows hang, hearts stall, and even falling gravel forgets which way is down. Only you still move. Hold your breath while casting to spare your companions. Every heartbeat the circle stands, the world collects its debt in magicule.
nusmp.skill.page_time_acceleration.descr: Your own clock runs ahead of everyone else's. Your feet land before the ground expects them and your blade arrives before the guard does. Arrows that come for you wade through honey, while you live a few heartbeats in the future.
nusmp.skill.page_time_reversal.descripti: Stone remembers being whole. You remind it. Walls broken in the last minute climb back into place, and wounded golems forget their wounds. The page refuses one thing: what has died stays dead. That kind of reversal is written on a page you should never find.
nusmp.skill.page_stolen_time.description: A slash that does not cut flesh so much as years. Those it touches wither, slow and grow brittle as their armor ages a lifetime in a breath. Time is never created, only moved; for a moment afterward, your own arms feel the theft.
nusmp.skill.book_time.description: A grimoire that keeps its own clock. Its pages stop a single foe, still a small circle of the world, quicken your steps, mend broken stone and steal a moment back - and every one of them sends the bill in magicule. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Passive, Time Sense: enemy projectiles that close in are caught in a small stasis bubble and slowed, and part of every wound is rewound three seconds later.
nusmp.page.book_time.chrono_stasis: The page does not ask. It folds the seconds in front of one enemy into a single held breath: no step, no swing, no fall. Strike hard enough and the moment cracks open early.
nusmp.page.book_time.grigora: You stop asking for single seconds and take a small circle of the world. Arrows hang, hearts stall, and gravel forgets which way is down - but you must stand still to hold it.
nusmp.page.book_time.acceleration: Your own clock runs a little ahead of everyone else's. Not much. Enough that your feet land before the ground expects them.
nusmp.page.book_time.reversal: Stone remembers being whole, and you remind it. A handful of broken blocks climb back into place. What has died stays dead; that page is not written here.
nusmp.page.book_time.stolen_time: A cut that takes a moment from the enemy - and time is never created, only moved. For as long as they stumble, so do you.
nusmp.page.book_time.chrono_anastasis: A clock face as wide as the battlefield opens overhead and its hands run backwards. Broken stone climbs back into place, your allies' wounds close, and spells still in the air are uncast. The dead stay dead.
nusmp.skill.book_fire.description: A grimoire that runs hot to the touch. Its pages throw exploding fire, spear a line of enemies and raise pillars of flame - and if a Fire Spirit Lord has sworn to you, Salamander may answer. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_water.description: A grimoire that never quite dries. Its pages call the Sea Dragon to strike, to hunt and to cradle your allies - and those bound to a Water Spirit Lord may hear Undine sing. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_wind.description: A grimoire whose pages turn on their own. It cuts with crescents of air, opens lanes of gale and, at its height, raises a storm around you - Sylph listens to those a Wind Spirit Lord has chosen. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_earth.description: A heavy grimoire that smells of rain on stone. It raises spikes and walls and splits the ground beneath your enemies - and Gnome stirs for those an Earth Spirit Lord has claimed. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_light.description: A grimoire that is never dark, even shut. It forms a blade of judgment and calls spears of light down on whoever it marks. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_dark.description: A grimoire that drinks the lantern light. It cuts with cloaked darkness, opens a hungry hole in the world, and at its finest slices through dimensions themselves. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_spatial.description: A grimoire that is a little larger inside. It plucks what flies at you out of the air, and opens paired gates that make distance a suggestion. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_lightning.description: A grimoire that crackles when it opens. Its lightning jumps from foe to foe, and its boots carry you forward with a charge saved for your next blow. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_steel.description: A grimoire bound in iron. It fires molten-bright steel and throws a lance that always comes home. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_mirror.description: Gauche's grimoire. Real ornate mirrors you summon out of violet mana: they catch spells and turn them back, shatter in place of a killing blow, carry you from glass to glass, and let living Real Doubles step out of them. Its power grows with your EP and armour. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_thread.description: A grimoire stitched with red thread. It binds the one you choose - and a small red cat called Rouge watches the thread of your life for one day at a time. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_plant.description: A grimoire that blooms when nobody is looking. It guides healing like a flower guidepost, and opens a dream world where your friends mend and your enemies stumble. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_sealing.description: A grimoire with a clasp that never quite opens for strangers. It seals other grimoires shut and closes wounds the wrong way for your enemies. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_gravity.description: A grimoire too heavy to lift without magic. It slams a single foe into the ground and spreads the presence of a demon king around you - which weighs on you too. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_ice.description: A grimoire cold enough to frost your fingers. It stops whatever it touches, then shatters it. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_mercury.description: A grimoire whose pages ripple like liquid metal. It lashes with a silver blade and pours itself into a shield around you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_fire.exploding_fireball: The first page every fire mage learns, and the last thing many enemies see. It flies, it lands, it blooms into flame.
nusmp.page.book_fire.sol_linea: A spear of spiraling sunfire that does not stop at the first body in its way. Nor the second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.calderos: Five circles bloom on the ground in the shape of a cross. A heartbeat later, they become pillars of fire.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leo_rugiens: The page roars before you do. A lion of living flame, big enough to ride, bounds from your side and runs your enemies down, then opens its jaws where it lands. (Fuegoleon and Leopold Vermillion's grimoires only.)
nusmp.page.book_water.waterball: A small sea dragon coils in your palm and leaves it hungry. It douses flames and knocks the breath out of whatever it hits.
nusmp.page.book_water.roar: The Sea Dragon wakes. It finds its prey on its own, and when it arrives the ground shakes with it.
nusmp.page.book_water.cradle: The water folds around you and those beside you. Inside, wounds close slowly and arrows forget how to fly.
nusmp.page.book_wind.kamaitachi: A crescent of wind sharp enough to cut through a line of enemies and lift them off their feet.
nusmp.page.book_wind.gust_lane: You open a corridor of gale. Enemies are thrown down it, arrows are torn apart in it, and your friends run faster through it.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_storm: A storm wakes around you and refuses to let go of anything nearby. It lifts, it spins, it does not care who stands in it.
nusmp.page.book_earth.spike_line: Stone spears break the ground one after another, racing away from you like a crack in ice.
nusmp.page.book_earth.wall: Mud Wall Partition - the ground stands up to defend you. It remembers to lie back down eight seconds later.
nusmp.page.book_earth.mother_earth_split: Divided Mother Earth - the earth opens in a long scar. Those standing on it are wounded, and the ground holds their feet a moment longer.
nusmp.page.book_light.judgment: Light Sword of Judgment - three geometric swords of light cross the field at light speed (the fastest spells in the mod). Light ignores armour and cuts the spirit; only an Aura barrier (30%+ aura) halves it.
nusmp.page.book_light.divine_punishment: Light Shaft of Divine Punishment - mark a foe; shafts of light fall on it from the sky in quick succession (more with higher EP).
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_slash: Dark Cloaked Avidya Slash - a flying wave of darkness, sharp as a blade, that swallows spells in mid-flight.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_hole: Black Hole - a small black hole that swallows spells within 5 m and briefly paralyses whoever cast them.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dimension_slash: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash - a downward slash of darkness that flies out and cuts mana, space and spells.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.domination: Sacred Mana Domination - the nearest enemy spell is erased from space, or else the target is pulled to you.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.fallen_angel_gat: Two gates, one hallway. Open the first, then the second, and for twenty seconds the distance between them is gone.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.chain: A bolt that refuses to stop at one. It leaps to the next foe, and the next.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_boots: Lightning in your heels: you are simply somewhere else, and the next thing you strike remembers the thunder.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_shot: Three bolts of white-hot steel, fired before you finish the word.
nusmp.page.book_steel.returning_lance: A lance thrown through everything in its path - and then, because it is yours, it comes back the same way.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_refrain: Reflect Refrain - a real mirror hangs before you for 4 s, catching 2-4 shots (by power), sending them back and jamming their casters' magic.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.real_double: Real Double - 1-3 living mirror doubles (by power) step out of mirrors, each costing a tenth of your max magicules, for 60 s. They wear your mirrored face, fight beside you, echo every spell you cast and draw enemies off you; a third of the blows aimed at you hit a double. Sneak-cast to trade places with the nearest one.
nusmp.page.book_thread.red_thread: A red thread ties the one you choose in place. It is thin. It does not break.
nusmp.page.book_thread.rouge: Red Thread of Fate: Rouge - a cat woven of red thread sits on your head for a day. If your thread is cut she ties it back to where you stood a few seconds before, and now and then she unravels to pull you out of a blow.
nusmp.page.book_plant.guidepost: Flowers bloom along a path from you to the one you look at, and their light mends what it touches.
nusmp.page.book_plant.hundred_flowers: A dream world of a hundred flowers opens around you. Friends rest in it; enemies are tangled in thorns.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal: A seal presses itself onto your target. A mage finds their grimoire shut; a monster finds its wounds closing the wrong way.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.grand_seal: Every enemy around you is sealed at once.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.heavy_infighting: One blow, and the ground rises to meet your enemy - then gravity forgets to let them go for a moment.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.demon_king: The weight of a demon king settles over everything near you. Your enemies sink and stagger - and so, a little, do you.
nusmp.page.book_ice.frost_lance: A lance of ice that slows what it pierces and leaves frost in the wound.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_prison: The target is sealed in ice. When it breaks, it breaks loudly.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_blade: Silver Blade - liquid mercury pours from your hand and hardens mid-flight into three razor spears. Mercury scales hard with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_shield: Silver Guardian - a dome of flowing mercury for 8 seconds: shots sink into it, blows land at half strength (fire melts through). When it ends it flows back into spears and hurls them at everything near.
item.nusmp.communication_magic_device.de: Right-click another device holder to link. Start a chat message with % to speak through it.
item.nusmp.mana_method_rune_stone.desc: Use in the air to store your last grimoire page, then use on the ground to arm it as a 5-minute trap.
item.nusmp.spirit_charm.desc: First Spirit Dive: consumed when the spirit chooses you. At 100 Trust, rename a charm at an anvil (its True Name) and sneak-use it to incarnate your spirit. After that, sneak-use to call or dismiss it.
item.nusmp.bond_thread.desc: Sneak-use on another player; if they do the same within 10 s, a red thread binds you. Heart grimoires become two hearts.
item.nusmp.fortune_die.desc: Roll it with a single-diamond grimoire: Good Fortune, or great misfortune.
item.nusmp.grimoire_chain.desc: While you carry it, nobody else can pick up your grimoire.
item.nusmp.anti_bird_charm.desc: A small black bird keeps you company. It does nothing useful at all.
item.nusmp.recovery_salve.desc: Heals a cracked heart or cracked diamond cover once, and clears a misfortune mark.
item.nusmp.written_consent.desc: Hold it to allow forbidden magic (such as Time Reversal on the Living) to be cast on you.
item.nusmp.devil_contract.desc: Use it to bargain with a devil. Choose your price. There is no taking it back.
nusmp.skill.book_sword.description: Every page is an edge. Throw a flying blade, rain a thousand swords on one spot, or let a domain of blades circle you and cut whatever comes close. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_explosion.description: Magic that does not ask politely. Burst shots, chained detonations and, when you are ready to be very loud, a grand explosion. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_magma.description: The earth's blood in your hands. Magma bullets that set foes alight, a pool of molten rock, and an eruption that splits the ground. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_mist.description: You are never quite where they think. Blinding veils, a step through the fog, and a prison of mist that swallows sight. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_star.description: Small stars that do not miss. Star shots, a starfall, and a constellation that hunts down everyone it can see. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_storm.description: Wind and lightning at once. A storm lance that pierces, a ring of tempest, and the calm, deadly eye of the storm. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_sand.description: The desert at your call. Sand spears, a blinding sandstorm and a quicksand tomb that holds your enemy in place. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_shadow.description: Darkness's quieter sibling. Step from one shadow to the one behind your enemy, bind them, then drown the area in shadow. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_poison.description: Patience, in liquid form. Venom bolts, a toxic cloud and a plague nova that eats away at everything near you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_reinforcement.descripti: Mana poured into your own body. Iron fists, a reinforced body that hits harder, and a full-body reinforcement that makes you a weapon. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_beast.description: The beast inside answers. Charge, roar, and finally take on a beast's form. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_bone.description: A grimoire that rattles. Bone spears, bone armor that bites back, and a field of bone spikes. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_blood.description: Every spell costs you a little of yourself - and takes back more. Blood bullets, crimson rain and a blood pact. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_creation.description: Magic given shape. A created blade, a created wall, and an arsenal of weapons orbiting you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_copy.description: You learn by being hit. Echo a bolt, or copy the last grimoire page that struck you in the last 20 seconds. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_illusion.description: Nothing here is real, and that is the danger. Phantom strikes, a decoy that steals your enemies' attention, and a mass illusion. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.book_dream.description: Dorothy Unsworth's magic. Dream World and Glamour World pull your foes out of reality into a dream dimension that is yours: say a thing inside it and it becomes real; the dream wears their minds down until they break. They escape only by breaking it from within (heavy damage, or Spatial, Time, Anti-Magic or a rival Dream mage) or by outlasting it. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_anti_magic.description: The magic that is not magic. It costs no mana, cuts spells out of the air and strips enemies of their protections. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.skill.forbidden_magic.description: Pages written in blood by a devil. Every spell has a price, every price stacks, and everyone nearby knows what you did. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast. Chant twice as long for Mana Zone (+25% size, +50% cost).
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devil_dive: The devil slides into your skin for eight seconds. Your spells cut a little deeper; your body pays every second.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.five_leaf_whi: Blank until a devil is bound. Then it is the devil's own spell, written in its own hand.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.life_exchange: Their wounds become yours - and you carry them worse than they did.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.reversal_livi: A consenting ally steps back four seconds into a healthier past. A sliver of your life stays behind as payment.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.underworld_ga: A rift opens for five seconds. The dead nearby are pulled toward it; the living inside are touched by darkness.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.mana_devour: Everything inside the circle starves - including you.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.curse_misfort: Misfortune, delivered by hand. A Diamond grimoire cracks under it; anyone else simply becomes unlucky.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.reincarnation: You write your soul into this place. Die within three days and you will return here - lighter by a page and some mana.
nusmp.page.book_sword.flying_blade: Origin Flash - a sword appears in your hand; one swing releases a giant slash that cuts everything in its path.
nusmp.page.book_sword.thousand_swords: Origin Flash Barrage - five giant slashes released at once, fanned out.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_domain: Demon-Dweller Sword: Conquering Eon - the sword drinks your allies' magic: one devastating slash that grows with every ally near you, and heals you.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.burst_shot: Burst Shot: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.chain_detonati: Chain Detonation: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.grand_explosio: Grand Explosion: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.heat_sphere: Heat Sphere: a page of Explosion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_bullet: Magma Bullet: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_pool: Magma Pool: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_magma.eruption: Eruption: a page of Magma Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_veil: Mist Veil: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_step: Mist Step: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_prison: Mist Prison: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_mist.steam_ball: Steam Ball: a page of Mist Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_shot: Star Shot: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.starfall: Starfall: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_star.constellation: Constellation: a page of Star Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.storm_lance: Storm Lance: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.tempest_ring: Tempest Ring: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.eye_of_the_storm: Eye of the Storm: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thunder_sphere: Thunder Sphere: a page of Storm Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_spear: Sand Spear: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sandstorm: Sandstorm: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_sand.quicksand_tomb: Quicksand Tomb: a page of Sand Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_step: Dark Garden Invitation - you sink into your shadow and rise from the shadow where you aim; allies at your side come along.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_bind: Kids' Playground - shadow hands rise round the place you aim and hold everything there.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_realm: Shadow Realm - the ground becomes shadow; foes in it are blind and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_bolt: Aufwachen Dachs - a badger of poison lunges at the foe.
nusmp.page.book_poison.toxic_cloud: Violett Schirm - a curtain of poison hangs in front of you; spells that cross it melt, foes that touch it sicken.
nusmp.page.book_poison.plague_nova: Basilisk's Breath - a cone of venom mist: burning poison and withering.
nusmp.page.book_poison.acid_ball: Acid Ball: a page of Poison Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.iron_fist: Iron Fist: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.mana_reinf: Mana Reinforcement: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.full_body: Full Body Reinforcement: a page of Reinforcement Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.beast_charge: Beast Charge: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.lions_roar: Lion's Roar: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_beast.beast_form: Beast Form: a page of Beast Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_spear: Bone Spear: a page of Bone Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_armor: Bone Armor: a page of Bone Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_bone.ossuary: Ossuary: a page of Bone Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_bullet: Blood Bullet: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_blood.crimson_rain: Crimson Rain: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_pact: Blood Pact: a page of Blood Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_blade: Creation: Blade: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_wall: Creation: Wall: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_creation.arsenal: Creation: Arsenal: a page of Creation Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_copy.echo_bolt: Echo Bolt: a page of Copy Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_copy.copy: Copy: a page of Copy Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.phantom_strike: Phantom Strike: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.decoy: Decoy: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.mass_illusion: Mass Illusion: a page of Illusion Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_haze: Dream Haze: a page of Dream Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.sweet_dream: Sweet Dream: a page of Dream Magic. Summon the grimoire, chant, and release.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_world: Dream World - pull the nearest two foes (8 blocks) into a small dream for 15 seconds. Inside, speak a thing (bear, feast, fire, ice, cage, stars, wall, sleep) and it becomes real.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.demon_slayer_: Demon-Dweller Sword: Black Slash - a flying anti-magic slash that cuts spells out of its path and knocks its target back.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_divider: Demon-Slayer Sword: Black Divider - the flat of the blade bats spells back, then a huge sweep of condensed anti-magic strips magic from all it hits.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_meteori: Black Meteorite - coated in anti-magic, you charge the target and cut; spells in the way are cut too.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_hurrica: Black Hurricane - you spin, drawn toward the magic around you, and every spell and trap nearby is nullified.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_form: Black Asta - anti-magic courses through your body: far stronger and faster, magic near you erodes. Twice a day; a third time costs you.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_lance: A lance of thunder, hurled true and straight.
nusmp.page.book_dark.death_thrust: Death Thrust - with Black Moon up, the whole zone is crushed into one thrust. Without it, it is only a thrust.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.space_cut: A blade of folded space. Distance offers no protection from it.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_sphere: A slow sphere of gravity that crushes what it reaches.
nusmp.page.book_steel.obsidian_shot: A cannonball of hardened steel, fired hard enough to knock giants back.
nusmp.page.book_earth.boulder_shot: The ground tears loose a boulder and throws it for you.
nusmp.skill.anti_magic_spirit_lord.descr: You have no mana, and so magic has no hold on you. Your body runs on Anti-Magic Power, gathered from every spell that strikes you. Toggle Black Form to let it pour out: magic cannot touch you, your blade cuts deeper, and the power drains with every second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.spirit_channeling: Hold to pull raw spirit energy: an aura grows around you and drags enemies in. Release at 25% for an elemental dash, 50% for a Spirit Nova, 100% to become a living conduit for six seconds.
nusmp.page.book_water.spirit_channeling: Hold to pull raw spirit energy: an aura grows around you and drags enemies in. Release at 25% for an elemental dash, 50% for a Spirit Nova, 100% to become a living conduit for six seconds.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_channeling: Hold to pull raw spirit energy: an aura grows around you and drags enemies in. Release at 25% for an elemental dash, 50% for a Spirit Nova, 100% to become a living conduit for six seconds.
nusmp.page.book_earth.spirit_channeling: Hold to pull raw spirit energy: an aura grows around you and drags enemies in. Release at 25% for an elemental dash, 50% for a Spirit Nova, 100% to become a living conduit for six seconds.
nusmp.skill.spirit_lord.description: A spirit lord has bound itself to you - no grimoire needed. Hold Spirit Channeling to fill the gauge and pull enemies in, then release: Overdrive at 25%, Nova at 50%, Cataclysm at 100%. Your body takes less from physical blows and falls cannot hurt you. Earn your spirit's full trust, give it a True Name, and call it to your side.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.bull_thrust: Bull Thrust - swords pointed ahead, you hurl yourself forward; every spell in front is dispelled on contact.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.infinite_slas: Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash - a large anti-magic slash from overhead that cuts a 24-block line.
Demon-Slasher Katana: Infinite Slash Equinox - a massive slash that travels very far and never harms your allies.
nusmp.page.book_sword.summon_demon_dwell: Sword Magic: draw Licht's white Demon-Dweller Sword from your grimoire for a minute.
nusmp.page.book_sword.summon_demon_destr: Sword Magic: draw Licht's white Demon-Destroyer Sword from your grimoire for a minute.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_blade: Dark Cloaked Black Blade - darkness coats the sword and forms a longer blade: more reach and bite for 30 s.
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_wild_slash: Dark Cloaked Avidya Wild Slash - swing wildly: a spray of Avidya Slashes.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_moon: Dark Cloaked Black Moon - Mana Zone: a black hole overhead swallows every enemy spell nearby for 10 s; allies' spells pass.
nusmp.page.book_dark.iai_slash: Dark Cloaked Iai Slash - the blade is drawn and you cut through the nearest foe. Deeper under Black Moon.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dimension_slash_equ: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash: Equinox - with Mana Zone, the Dimension Slash reaches enormously far. (Yami Sukehiro's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_fire.spiral_flame: Spiral Flame - a vortex of flame drills forward, piercing and burning everything in its path, then bursts where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_fire.wild_bursting_flame: Wild Bursting Flame - flame bursts out of you in every direction, three waves, each one throwing your enemies back.
nusmp.page.book_fire.ignis_columna: Ignis Columna - a towering column of flame erupts where you aim and keeps burning, lifting whatever stands inside it.
nusmp.page.book_water.aqua_javelin: Aqua Javelin - a lance of high-pressure water, dense enough to pierce a whole line of enemies.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragons_nest: Sea Dragon's Nest - a dome of whirling water rises over you: enemy spells inside are swallowed, foes are slowed and battered, allies heal.
nusmp.page.book_water.valkyrie_dress: Valkyrie Dress - water becomes armour: for thirty seconds you are faster, stronger, harder to hurt and light on your feet.
nusmp.page.book_earth.witch_hunter_claws: Witch Hunter Claws - stone claws burst out of the ground round your target and clamp shut, crushing it and holding it in place.
nusmp.page.book_earth.rampaging_mother_e: Rampaging Mother Earth - the ground heaves in a rolling wave that tears eighteen blocks ahead, throwing everything in its way into the air.
nusmp.page.book_wind.towering_tornado: Towering Tornado - a huge tornado where you aim: it drags enemies in and up, shreds them and swallows their spells.
nusmp.page.book_wind.slicing_wind_empero: Slicing Wind Emperor - a vast crescent made of countless wind blades sweeps far ahead, cutting spells and everything else in its path.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_zephyr: Spirit of Zephyr - the wind spirit wraps you for thirty seconds: very fast, light as air, and enemy spells are blown away before they reach you. (Yuno's grimoire only.)
nusmp.skill.book_transmutation.descripti: Grey's attribute: take a substance apart and put it back together as something else - stone into iron, ground into sand, an enemy's spell into your own mana. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_ash.description: Zora Ideale's attribute, born of Fire: ash that blinds, ash circles that drink the mana of everyone inside, ash traps for whoever dares strike you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_cotton.description: Charmy Pappitson's grimoire of two halves. When it binds it leans to Cotton (sheep that cook, bind and carry) or to Food (a glutton's maw that eats magic and turns it into your mana). Charmy's own book holds both. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_recombination.descripti: Henry Legolant's attribute: the magic house rearranges itself at your call - walls, swapped rooms, a drill of mana, and in Henry's hands the Raging Black Bull. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
item.nusmp.gauches_hand_mirror.desc: Sneak-use to leave a mirror where you stand; use it to step back through that mirror from anywhere in the same world (30 s cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_thread.arachnes_web: Arachne's Web - a web of thread spreads where you aim; everything caught in it is held fast and slowly cut.
nusmp.page.book_thread.dancing_doll: Dancing Doll - puppet threads take a foe: for three seconds it walks where you look, and a monster turns on its own side.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_mending: Thread Magic: Mending - you sew wounds shut: you and the allies near you heal, poison and withering are drawn out.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.sealing_chains: Seal Magic: Sealing Chains - rune chains bind one foe. It cannot move, and a mage cannot open their grimoire.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.trinity_seal: Trinity Seal Magic - three seals close on the foe and crystallise its mana: a third of it is gone, and it is sealed and weakened.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_barrier: Seal Magic: Barrier - seal chains ring you for eight seconds; enemy spells that reach them are sealed away, allies inside are harder to hurt.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_fiend: Thunder Fiend - lightning wreathes your body for thirty seconds: very fast, and every blow arcs to a second foe. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_lightning.pulsaranta: Pulsaranta - three balls of lightning that hunt the target and burst.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.rising_salim: God of Lightning Rising Salim - a pillar of lightning crashes down where you aim and throws everything up.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderbird_ca: Thunderbird Cavalry: Sky-Splitting Magic Bow Armament - a volley of lightning arrows that seek their marks.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.black_lightnin: Black Lightning Battle Fiend - black lightning: faster, stronger, and every blow arcs to two more foes. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_spatial.unopening_red_ro: Unopening Red Room - the foe is shut in a room of folded space; walking out of it walks back in.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.myriad_black: Myriad Black - space is cut over and over in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.door_of_fate: Door of Fate - a dimensional gate opens beside you; three seconds later you and the allies by you step through to your spawn point.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.reflect_ray: Reflect Ray - a mirror opens and looses 3-5 rays of reflected light (by power) that wound the spirit; your doubles fire with you.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.large_reflect_ray: Large Reflect Ray - a great mirror and a great ray.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.full_reflection: Full Reflection - for 8 s a great mirror turns back every shot and returns 60% of every blow to whoever struck.
nusmp.page.book_fire.calidos_brachium: Calidos Brachium - arms of flame smash everything in front of you. (Mereoleona Vermillion's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_plant.yggdrasil: World Tree Magic: Yggdrasil - a great tree of mana: allies heal and regenerate, foes are held by its roots. (William Vangeance's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_plant.briar_prison: Briar Magic: Briar Prison - a prison of thorny briars grows round the place you aim. (Charlotte Roselei's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_rain: Silver Rain - a cloud of mercury overhead lets fall a storm of needle-fine spears where you aim. (Nozel Silva)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.heavens_shadow_se: Heaven's Shadow Second Sight - every shadow is your eye: all living things within 32 blocks show through walls.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis: Unite Mode: Canis - united with the dog devil: fast and relentless. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_gallus: Unite Mode: Gallus - united with the bird devil: leaping and gliding. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis_felis: Unite Mode: Canis x Felis - two devils at once: fast, strong and hard to hurt. (Nacht Faust's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_poison.curse_workers_nei: Curse-Worker's Neighbor - curses reworked: your side is cleansed, and the curses fall on your foes. (Gordon Agrippa's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_sword.ripper_cut: Slash Magic: Ripper Cut - blades on every limb, a storm of cuts in front of you. (Jack the Ripper's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_creation.painted_menager: Painting Magic: Painted Menagerie - painted beasts leap off the canvas and fight for you for thirty seconds. (Rill Boismortier's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_dream.glamour_world: Glamour World - a multi-hued mist drags up to eight foes (12 blocks) into your great dream for 30 seconds: a pastel world under an iridescent dome where your words become solid. Their dream load climbs until their minds break. (Dorothy Unsworth's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_storm.vortex_shield: Vortex Magic: Vortex Shield - the Kingdom's Ultimate Shield: a vortex wall round you that turns spells aside and pushes foes away. (Kaiser Granvorka's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.iron_spike: Transmutation: Iron Spikes - the ground ahead turns to iron and thrusts up in a line.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.magic_conv: Magic Convert - a transmutation circle in front of you; every enemy spell that touches it becomes your mana.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.quagmire: Transmutation: Quagmire - the ground where you aim turns to sand; everything in it sinks and drags.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.grand_tran: Grand Transmutation - every blessing on the foes around you is turned into its curse, and you take the blessings.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_bullets: Ash Bullets - a spray of ash bullets that blind what they hit.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_cloud: Ash Cloud - you vanish in a cloud of ash; everyone near you is blinded.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_absorbing_format: Ash Absorbing Formation - a ring of ash where you aim drinks the mana of every foe inside and pours it into you.
nusmp.page.book_ash.revelation_of_the_co: Revelation of the Cowardly - for thirty seconds the next three foes who strike you set off an ash trap, and everything hiding nearby is revealed. (Zora Ideale's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sleeping_sheep_st: Sleeping Sheep Strike - a cotton sheep bounds at the foe and puts it to sleep.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_cook: Sheep Cook - cotton sheep chefs cook for everyone near you: healing, filling, a lasting regeneration. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_bondage: Sheep Bondage - a cotton sheep wraps the foe in cotton and holds it. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_cloud: Cotton Cloud - cotton lifts you and your allies, then lets you float down. (Cotton half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.gourmets_bite: Gourmet's Bite - a mouthful of the foe's mana. (Food half.)
nusmp.page.book_cotton.gluttons_banquet: Glutton's Banquet - a giant maw eats every spell in front of you and bites the foes there, turning it all into your mana. (Food half.)
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mana_corks: Mana Corkscrew - a drill of compressed mana spirals out and bores through a line.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.bulwark: Recombination: Bulwark - the magic house folds a ring of walls round you for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.room_swap: Recombination: Room Swap - two rooms change places: you and the target swap positions.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.raging_bla: The Raging Black Bull - the magic house rebuilds itself into a fighting bull that guards you for a minute. (Henry Legolant's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_dream.imagination_manife: Imagination Manifestation - inside your own dream, the next thing you imagine becomes real at what you look at (a giant stuffed bear, a feast, a ring of fire, an ice prison, a bird cage, falling stars, a candy wall, a lullaby).
nusmp.skill.book_painting.description: Rill Boismortier's magic. Summoning the grimoire manifests a wooden palette (off hand) and a mana brush (main hand). Right-click the palette to change the paint (fire, water, ice, wind, earth, lightning or ink); sneak + right-click to answer the last element that hit you. Right-click the brush to paint with it (uses aura). What you paint comes to life, your mood feeds your imagination (joy boosts it, frustration stifles it), and your EP and gear make every painting stronger.
nusmp.page.book_painting.brushstroke: Brushstroke - fling a wet stroke in your current paint: it hurts, slows, carries the paint's element and leaves a sticky puddle where it lands.
nusmp.page.book_painting.spring_of_restr: Spring of Restriction - a spring of sticky paint wells up under the target and sets like lacquer, holding everything in it fast.
nusmp.page.book_painting.camouflage: Camouflage - paint yourself into the scenery: invisible for 15 seconds, until you strike.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_gian: Souterrain Giant's Strong Arm - a painted giant's arm bursts up from the ground and flings the target skyward.
nusmp.page.book_painting.deux_tempetes: Deux Tempêtes of Fire and Ice - two painted storms turn round you for five seconds: one burns, one freezes.
nusmp.page.book_painting.gods_game: God's Game - a painted world of your own rules for eight seconds: shots that reach you turn to paint, and you are hard to hurt.
nusmp.page.book_painting.elemental_quint: Elemental Quintet - five strokes of five elements at once (fire, water, wind, earth, lightning) on up to five foes.
nusmp.page.book_painting.master_of_valha: Master of Valhalla - a painted host of einherjar charges out ahead of you, cutting down everything in its path; four of them step off the canvas and stay to fight.
nusmp.page.book_painting.painted_menager: Painted Menagerie - three painted beasts leap off the canvas in your current paint and fight for you for thirty seconds. Their bites carry the paint's element. (Rill Boismortier)
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirror_array: Mirror Array - 3-5 mirrors of every shape orbit you for 40 s. They catch enemy shots and send them back (jamming the shooter), and one shatters in place of any heavy or killing blow.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirror_step: Mirror Step - step into a mirror and out of another where you look, up to 32 blocks away.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_slash: Mirrors Slash - blade-edged mirrors spin out in a wide arc in front of you. The cut glass leaves your foes fragile.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_meteorite: Mirrors Meteorite - a storm of mirrors falls where you aim and bursts into blinding glare and razor glass.
nusmp.page.book_painting.living_illustra: Living Illustration - paint an einherjar on the ground before you (sneak: a giant); the drawing stands up as a solid, living construct of paint for thirty seconds. Up to three at once (four when you're happy).
nusmp.page.book_painting.counter_palette: Counter Palette - your paint turns into the element that answers the last one that hit you (water against fire, ice against water, fire against ice, earth against wind and lightning, wind against earth); for six seconds that element barely touches you.
item.nusmp.paint_brush.desc: Right-click: a sweep of your current paint (uses aura). Manifested by a Painting grimoire.
item.nusmp.paint_palette.desc: Right-click: change the paint. Sneak + right-click: answer the last element that hit you. Held, it softens the element its paint counters.
nusmp.page.book_light.healing_ray: Healing Ray of Light - a ray to the ally you look at (or yourself) that mends wounds and burns away one affliction.
nusmp.page.book_light.lamp_of_avior: Lamp of Avior Gloria - a lamp of light hangs over you and rains light swords on every foe in reach for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_light.light_speed: Light Speed - become light and arrive up to 24 blocks ahead in an instant, cutting through what stands between. Uses aura.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_eagle: Silver Eagle - a giant eagle of living mercury swoops along your line of sight, scattering and cutting all it passes. Its wingspan grows with your EP.
nusmp.skill.book_world_tree.description: William Vangeance's magic: gigantic world trees. Roots and trees grow out of the ground (and go again), bind foes, catch spells in mid-air and drink their mana, sharing it with you and your allies.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mistilteinn_s: Mistilteinn Seed - a seed of the world tree; where it strikes, roots burst out, bind the foe and drink its magicules into you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_bind: Root Bind - roots tear up under the foe you look at, hold it, drain it, then drag it toward you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.magic_tree_de: Magic Tree Descent - a world tree comes down where you aim and stands for 20 seconds: its roots bind and drain foes around it, and what it drinks flows to you and your allies, who mend in its shade.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.budding_of_yg: Budding of Yggdrasil - twelve great roots burst up in a ring around you: every foe inside is bound and drained for 5 seconds, and enemy shots are caught in mid-air.
nusmp.skill.book_dice.description: Dice whose power is the pips rolled. Elemental Dice rolls two etched d6 (fire, earth, water, wind, lightning, light); the Fate Die plays by D&D rules - a natural 1 fumbles and jams your magic, a natural 20 is a critical hit that ignores every resistance. Your EP is your modifier.
nusmp.page.book_dice.elemental_dice: Elemental Dice - roll 2d6: the higher face picks the element, the pips the power (sum / 7), and doubles resonate (x1.5).
nusmp.page.book_dice.fate_die: Fate Die - roll a d20 plus your modifier: under 10 the spell glances, higher it grows; a natural 1 is a critical fumble, a natural 20 a critical hit (maximum power, armour and resistances ignored, heavy spiritual damage).
nusmp.page.book_dice.gamblers_fallacy: Gambler's Fallacy - three d20s in a row on the same foe; every roll under 10 adds +3 to the next ones (it's due!). A natural 1 ends the streak.
nusmp.page.book_dice.loaded_dice: Loaded Dice - for 30 seconds every roll has advantage (roll twice, keep the higher) and a natural 1 is rerolled once.
nusmp.skill.book_slash.description: Jack the Ripper's magic: mana blades that can cut anything. Every cut on a defended foe reads its defence and marks it for good; ten marks and its armour, barriers and resistances no longer stop you.
nusmp.page.book_slash.slash_wave: Slash Wave - a jagged crescent of green mana flung from the forearm, cutting through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_slash.forearm_blades: Forearm Blades - long jagged blades along both forearms for 20 seconds; every melee blow cuts harder and adapts. Held with aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.ripper_dash: Ripper Dash - a burst of speed that carries you 10 blocks through your foes, cutting each one. Uses aura.
nusmp.page.book_slash.death_scythe: Death Scythe - a vast scythe of slash magic reaps everything around you in one sweep.
nusmp.skill.book_compass.description: Letoile Becquerel's magic: brass compasses hover behind you. Their needles lock onto the strongest magicule signature in sight and follow it anywhere, and they can wrench enemy spells round onto a new heading.
nusmp.page.book_compass.useless_north: Useless North - the compasses turn to your target and loose needles that follow it wherever it goes.
nusmp.page.book_compass.willful_compass: Willful Compass - for 10 seconds the compasses wrench every incoming shot round and send it back at whoever fired it.
nusmp.page.book_compass.another_atlas: Another Atlas - chart a foe's magicule signature for 15 seconds: it glows, your needles always find it, and the array fires on it by itself.
nusmp.page.book_compass.compass_rose: Compass Rose - every needle swings at once: each foe within 20 blocks is locked and struck by two homing needles.
